verdict.rationale: Aleph's own materials claim bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows with pull/push sync. They also reference first-party Excel and Google Sheets add-ins backed by a shared data layer that keeps models in sync. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how edits push back (write-back scope, conflict handling, refresh cadence) and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As a finance lead, a bi-directional Excel or Google Sheets add-in pulls live data into my spreadsheets and pushes edits back

citations.quote: Bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows, including pull/push sync, reporting automation, and drill-down.
Leverage the same data layer that powers our Excel and Google Sheets add-ins
Supercharge your existing reporting packages and financial models with a single source of truth that keeps everything in sync.
